description: A request exceeds the maximum encoded frame payload.

transport.construction: Encode the prefix {"protocolVersion":{"major":1,"minor":0},"type":"submit","requestId":"req-large","padding":" and suffix "} as UTF-8, then insert enough ASCII x bytes between them for the total payload to equal exactly 1048577 bytes.

requiredBehavior: Reject as soon as payload exceeds 1048576 bytes and before JSON decoding or dispatch.
No root, model call, or tool call is created.
If stdout remains writable emit only a bounded error; otherwise terminate nonzero without logging payload bytes.
